::: {#exm-t-dist}
#### t quantiles approach Gaussian quantiles

The 0.975 quantile of $t_k$ is larger than
the standard Gaussian's 0.975 quantile, `r round(qnorm(0.975), 3)`,
and approaches it as $k$ grows:

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
k <- c(4, 9, 29, 99, 2760)
tibble::tibble(k = k, t_quantile = qt(0.975, df = k))
```

So t-based intervals and tests differ noticeably from Gaussian-based ones
only in small samples.
:::
